declaration: exploratory v4 post-results analysis; classification rules recorded before this failure breakdown/case-text inspection; not preregistered and not a tuning basis
unit: dataset/question/pipeline with both generators at repetition 1
eligibility: at least one paired generator has exact_match < 1; candidate stratum has top-50 evidence coverage < 1; packing stratum has top-50 = 1 and packed < 1; answer stratum has packed = 1
selection: in declared dataset/stratum order, sort eligible pairs by digest([salt,seed,dataset,stratum,question_id,pipeline_id]); take one with a question ID not previously selected in that dataset; report empty strata without replacement
pairing: require identical candidate IDs, final candidate order and context across generators; keep both answers even if only one fails
baselines: include gold and no-RAG repetition-one responses for the same selected question and both generators, separately labeled
interpretation: annotation evidence coverage is not semantic sufficiency; non-exact answers may be scoring/format differences; sampled cases cannot estimate failure prevalence or establish causal attribution
validation: python -m unittest discover -s tests -p test_failure_review.py -v; recheck analysis proof, raw hashes/chains, ID-only deterministic sample and prepared source identities; verify scores and packed source offsets
command: python -m ragbench_lab failure-review --report-dir reports/stage-b-analysis-v4-50 --proof artifacts/stage-b-analysis-verification-v4-50.json --main-run runs/stage-b-evaluation-v4-50 --baseline-run runs/baseline-evaluation-v4-50 --squad-dir data/prepared/squad-study-v1 --hotpot-dir data/prepared/hotpot-study-v1 --protocol configs/failure-review-protocol-v4-50.json --output reports/stage-b-failure-review-v4-50

exhaustive_diagnostics.unit: one first-attempt main response at repetition one; 2400 responses over 100 question IDs; not 2400 independent questions
exhaustive_diagnostics.failure_rule: normalized exact_match < 1; report zero-token-F1 and positive-token-F1 mismatches separately
exhaustive_diagnostics.annotation_limits: SQuAD needs any complete annotated answer span; Hotpot needs all annotated supporting sentences. Missing annotations are not proof of insufficient semantic evidence; non-exact answers are not automatically factually wrong.
exhaustive_diagnostics.coexisting_flags: also record any packed coverage drop from top50 even when candidate evidence was already incomplete
exhaustive_diagnostics.statistics: descriptive per-response counts and within-group rates; no pooled timing repetitions or new confidence claims
exhaustive_diagnostics.baseline_policy: separately label no-RAG/gold controls; do not classify as main retrieval errors
